A '''solar sailer''' was a class of [[starship]] [[yacht]] that used sails to absorb stray [[Realspace|space]] energies as a source of almost limitless [[fuel]].<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> During the [[High Republic Era]], [[Hutt Clan]] [[Dreadcruiser]]s were solar sailers.<ref name="LitD">{{StoryCite|story=Light in the Darkness|book=The High Republic: Tales of Light and Life}}</ref> [[Count]] [[Dooku]] [[Count Dooku's solar sailer|owned]] a [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]]<ref name="Episode II" /> during the [[Clone Wars]] that he had modified to include a solar sail.<ref name="Ships of the Galaxy">''[[Star Wars: Ships of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
